source_clarification: Existing Equipment UI is battle-only; existing tests explicitly prohibit costume UI. Discovery preserves the exact stored battle and costume snapshots and does not introduce costume actions.
rendering: Search uses existing view-model displayed names/keys/slots. Query/slot reveal matching owned rows;20-item filtered pages avoid expanding hundreds of cards. Original category fold preferences, equipped identity, optimizer and preset drafts remain separate.
focus: Typing and slot selection retain focus. Explicit View results or Enter jumps to the selected visible category or results heading; empty reset returns to search.
wire: No new Habitica endpoint, formula or provider command. Synthetic native fixture includes303 owned records and a fixed content catalogue.
